topic: Manage Employee Bank Details and Payment Mode
summary: This topic explains how to enter and manage an employee's bank details and specify their salary payment mode (e.g., RTGS, Cheque) within their salary details section.
steps: Click on the employee's record to view their details.
Enter the employee's "Bank Name", "Branch", "Account Number", and "IFSC Code".
In the "Payment Mode" field or "Remarks" section, specify the payment method (e.g., "RTGS", "Cheque").
business_rules: Bank details entered here will reflect on the employee's salary slip.
important_notes: Specifying the payment mode (e.g., "Cheque") in remarks can help in identifying how salary will be disbursed.
Once saved, these details are permanent and do not need to be re-entered each month.
questions: How do I add an employee's bank account details for salary processing?
Where can I specify if an employee's salary will be paid via cheque or RTGS?
Will the bank details appear on the salary slip?
